facts.fact: Rack Centre's spec sheet describes its carrier-neutral Lagos facility LGS1 as an existing facility operating with zero downtime since inception in 2013, with 1.5 MW IT power and 34 standard cabinets in caged space; the sheet is dated 2024-05 (upload path), the operating start is 2013.

Rack Centre states that LGS1 in Lagos is certified Tier III for Constructed Facility and Design Documents (TCCF and TCCD, Uptime Institute terms); the sheet gives no certification date and is dated 2024-05 (upload path), which is used as as_of.
